title: Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit - Pod Salt Edition
description: The Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Prefilled Pod Kit is an innovative dual-flavour vape system created in collaboration with nic salt specialists, Pod Salt. Designed for simplicity, portability, and satisfaction, this compact device holds two 2ml prefilled pods side-by-side, allowing you to switch between flavours on demand—no refills, no mess, just smooth, flavourful vapour with every puff. Powered by a 600mAh rechargeable battery, the Pyne Pod delivers up to 1500 puffs per kit and features rapid USB-C charging to keep you going for longer. The smart magnetic pod system makes swapping pods easy, while the device’s automatic inhale activation keeps things intuitive and button-free. Each edition of the Pyne Pod Kit includes two preloaded pods in distinct yet complementary flavour pairings, from juicy fruit blends to fresh beverages to cooling menthol fusions. Whether you enjoy deep berry flavours like Blue Raspberry and Mr Blue, tropical favourites like Mango and Peach, or a bracing hit of Cherry Ice and Fizzy Cherry, there’s a Pyne Pod edition to suit your taste. For those looking to explore more convenient, high-quality devices like this, check out our full range of Prefilled Pod Kits to discover a variety of flavours and kits. Slim, pocket-sized and beginner-friendly, the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 is a great choice for adult vapers seeking a compact alternative to disposables, with the added benefit of two unique flavour experiences in a single device. Plus, with replacement pods sold in packs of two and available in 20 premium Pod Salt flavours, you can customise your flavour setup endlessly with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Prefilled Pod Kit. Pull the mouthpiece out and insert the pod in the empty slot. 2. Insert the cartridge in the device with the desired flavour facing the Pod Salt Logo. 3.
